label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_20
text: The decision to allow you to take on the League\nwas irregular. An exception among exceptions...[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_21
text: I was against it, as you know. But the academy\nallowed it, and their ruling is absolute.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_22
text: Therefore, I will carry out my duty as a member\nof the Elite Four as flawlessly as I always do.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_01
text: The Elite Trial I devised starts right here.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_02
text: I call my challenge...the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Flying Time Trial[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_03
text: You will need to fly around the skies of the\nTerarium while riding a Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_04
text: Reach the goal within the prescribed time, and\nyou will pass the trial.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_05
text: Fly through the Magnemite rings, and extra time\nwill be added to the countdown.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_06
text: I recommend you go through as many rings as\npossible as you fly toward the goal.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_07
text: Can you verify that you are ready and willing to\ntake on my Flying Time Trial?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_select_01
text: I’m ready!

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_select_02
text: Explain again?

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_select_03
text: Maybe later

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_08
text: Understood.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_23
text: I assume you have a Pokémon to ride on. Please\nbring it out of its ball.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_legend_01
text: Agias!

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_24
text: ...Ah, good. With some effort, this Pokémon\nshould be capable of flight.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_25
text: Your name is Agias, yes? This is for you to eat.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_legend_02
text: *chomp chomp* *snarf* *chomp*

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_legend_03
text: Agiaaas!

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_system_01
text: Koraidon is brimming with power!

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_system_02
text: Miraidon is brimming with power!

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_26
text: What your Agias just consumed is a supplement\nthat enhances a Pokémon’s flight capabilities.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_27
text: I prepared it using the leaves of a mysterious\nplant that was found growing in the Terarium.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_28
text: Your Agias will be able to soar through the skies\nas it pleases—but only for the duration of the trial.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_29
text: You have all you need to begin the challenge.\nI wish you luck.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_09
text: That was an impressive display of punctuality.\nI must admit, it was satisfying to watch you fly.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_10
text: Congratulations. You have cleared my Elite Trial.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_19
text: Now, a change of location is required once again.\nCome.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_11
text: It seems this attempt was a failure.\c\nThose who cannot even keep to a time limit can\nhardly expect to keep anything together.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_12
text: If you wish to reattempt my trial, please come\nand speak with me again.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_13
text: You failed yet again...[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_14
text: I now find myself strangely at a loss over the\ncorrect course of action.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_15
text: You have failed my trial many times over, yes, but\nyou always pick yourself up to try once more.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_16
text: That in itself could be considered more noble\nthan reaching a goal within a set time.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_30
text:
...I will count your numerous attempts at my trial
as proof of your worthiness. You pass.\c
This seems a fitting result for someone whose
very presence in the club is already exceptional.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: sdc02_4kings_b_02_nerine_17
text: However, be warned that you will find no such\nleniency when you face me in battle.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
